clock.chronology: W38 predeclared first scoring, W39 later descriptive scoring; both historically globally exposed across MXM. No independent confirmation, no W46 use.
clock.sessionDst: September 2026 Europe/London observes BST UTC+1 (07:00 UTC is 08:00 London local), New York EDT UTC-4 (13:00 UTC is 09:00 NYC). Signal sessions are fixed UTC, no inference from unverified broker holiday calendars.
clock.sourceM5: Original LIVE Pepperstone original EUR account, genuine read-only M5, GBP/USD conversion not required; EURUSD solely USD->EUR conversion, original causal BID and ASK <=60s old at M5 clock plus 1.5s, three contiguous completed M5 -> M15; no mid synthetic quote, no DOM claims.
clock.brokerValidation: Enabled symbols USD quoted, current minimum volume step lot and expected margins each <=EUR300, commission/floor, swap details, causal matched EURUSD quote, enforce no source fallback.
clock.sourceEvidence: CMA1 AUDUSD current min margin 30.97 EUR; CMA2 NatGas current min margin 24.74 EUR and only one valid sampled pair. Recheck original contract. These are historic observations, not predictive outcomes.
clock.historicalCostLabel: Current original broker tariff metadata retrospective historical scenario only, slippage modeled, no authentic historic fills, no full path DD certification

candidates.mechanism: After US liquidity injection and initial volatility, four sequential M15 bars contract to <=0.75 mean normalized true-range of previous twelve; last completed price diverges >=1.25 times prior12 mean raw range from prior12 mean close but final M15 body starts pointing back to that prior mean; tick volume latest >=0.75 times prior12 M15 average and real spread <=0.50 times last bar range. Fade towards prior mean.
candidates.session: Weekdays 13:00–19:00 UTC only; explicitly NOT a claim of EIA release-time synchronization
candidates.causalInputs: 16 contiguous M15 closes (12 prior / 4 recent), last close strictly earlier than decision clock, no forward fill, recent 4 H1 equivalent; current observed NatGas as-of BID/ASK
candidates.signalDirection: sign(prior12 meanClose - lastM15 close), with latest candle body signed in same direction
candidates.driver: absolute difference between prior mean and current close divided by current close
candidates.exit: native M15_EQUILIBRIUM_REVERSION mean of prior8 M15, protective 1.5 ATR14 M5 and max 105m, future bid/ask only
candidates.size: original current broker min volume, one EUR300 common allocator
candidates.independentOf: Previously closed Brent->Crude lead/lag and US500 H1 momentum; this is NG-specific H1 range compression with mean-reversion hypothesis

candidates.mechanism: Late Asian 02:00–05:00 UTC established high/low from 12 contiguous completed M15 bars. During 07:00–09:30 UTC, newest fully closed M15 breaches Asian extreme by >=0.15 times mean Asian M15 candle range but closes back inside with body in reversal direction, latest tick volume >=0.85 of Asian mean, original as-of spread <=0.40 of signal-bar high-low. Trade against rejected sweep. No second cross-sectional FX factor or M5 shock rule.
candidates.session: Weekdays 07:00–09:30 UTC, London local BST 08:00–10:30 during these dates
candidates.causalInputs: 12 contiguous M15 02:00–05:00 same UTC date and latest completed M15 decision strictly before M5 quote clock, no future extrema
candidates.signalDirection: short after failed upper sweep; long after failed lower sweep, one signal per completed M15
candidates.driver: absolute distance between sweep high/low and late-Asia boundary divided by current close
candidates.exit: native M15_VOLATILITY_TARGET, quote-side -1.5 ATR14 M5, max 120m, no intrabar assumed fill
candidates.size: original current broker min volume, one EUR300 common allocator
candidates.independentOf: Previously closed FX M5 expansion shock, FX breadth factor, M5 tick-absorption, index residual fade

benchmark.cash: zero with same interval, no ghost fills
benchmark.alwaysLong: same observed entry/exit quote clocks/units and cost, descriptive, never separately financed
benchmark.alwaysShort: same observed entry/exit quote clocks/units and cost, descriptive, never separately financed
benchmark.flippedSignal: inverse side at same observed entry/exit, costs + financing, descriptive conditional benchmark only
benchmark.rule: report NET vs long, short, flipped sign and cash; positive absolute NET alone is insufficient

portfolio.cost: actual historical independently observed original BID/ASK + contractual commission floor and conversion + modeled nonzero slippage and financing, explicitly conditional historical scenario
portfolio.jointCapital: same original NativeFundedSession + NativeHistoricalProductReplay, two EUR300 funded family-only ablations never added
portfolio.report: model funded roundtrips per week vs HARD21 (>=21 each eligible week), maximum USED margin vs changing equity, sampled central/adverse equity and max DD with continuity caveat; gross, central/adverse NET, matched benchmarks, capital drawdown, signal counts, exit/rejection categories
portfolio.promote: do not promote based on already exposed dates, incomplete cost or M5 sampling; >=12months authentic chrono and genuinely unexposed confirmation plus system HARD21 and max continuous DD30 required
